cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Absolutely, I'll move forward for the photo. Forward means facing the camera; I'm perfectly placed in this shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Certainly. Feet are units of zoom. Increase yours by two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A full portrait means all the important parts. You've captured me completely.
